name: checkout-independent-code-anchors
body: A durable `implemented-by` anchor must be a checkout-independent FQN (a Module, Struct or Function — e.g. a suite symbol's `apg-opencode-suite.<relpath>.<symbol>` or a Rust `apg.<module>.<fn>`). An absolute File-path FQN embeds the checkout/worktree directory, so the same file resolves to a different FQN in a worktree than on `main` and the main rebuild reports spec drift — File paths must never be durable anchors (they are fine as transient plan task targets).
